summary.text: Nate McMurray is the Democratic candidate for the New York State Assembly, District 145, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Becky Wydysh (Republican and Conservative Party) for a seat with no incumbent.
He was the Democratic nominee for U.S. House in New York's 27th District in 2018 and 2020.

paragraphs.text: Nate McMurray's 2018 campaign website, as reproduced by Ballotpedia, described him as the Town Supervisor of Grand Island.
That year he was the Democratic candidate for U.S. House New York District 27 and lost to incumbent Chris Collins, 48.8 percent to 49.1 percent.
He ran in the district again in 2020 as the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate and lost to incumbent Christopher Jacobs, 39.0 percent to 59.7 percent.
In 2024 Ballotpedia lists him among the withdrawn or disqualified candidates in the Democratic primary for U.S. House New York District 26.
